template.name: Landflow failures → Landfall
template.description: When a workflow fails, open (or attach to) a Landfall incident with the workflow, the failing node, the error and a link to the execution.

credentials.name: Landfall
credentials.description: Base URL, org slug, an lf_key_ API key, the remote-source ingest token and its connection ID.

setup: Pick the **Landfall** credential (a remote-source connection: base URL, org slug, API key, ingest token, connection ID).
Make this the error workflow of the workflows that matter: their **Settings → Error workflow**.
Repeat failures of the same node attach to the open room (the dedup key is workflow and node), so a flapping workflow is one room, not twenty.
